newsitem.title: USA: Tellabs Q1 net up after stock sale gain.
newsitem.headline: Tellabs Q1 net up after stock sale gain.

text.p: Tellabs Inc said Thursday its earnings climbed to record levels in the first quarter after the company recorded a pre-tax gain of $20.8 million on the sale of stock held as an investment.
The company reported net income of $63.1 million, or $0.34 a share, in the period ended March 28, compared to $31.1 million, or $0.17 a share, one year ago.
Sales in the quarter totaled $247.1 million, up from $172.3 million in the corresponding period in 1996.
Tellabs designs and makes voice and data transmission systems. Its shares closed off 1-1/4 Thursday at 37-7/8.
